# Amarachi Investment Company Ltd

https://www.amarachitz.com

Amarachi Investment Company Ltd is a Tanzanian company delivering civil works, building construction, transportation logistics, and heavy equipment solutions across Tanzania.

## About

Amarachi Investment Company Ltd provides dependable construction and infrastructure services. The company owns and operates a modern fleet of heavy equipment and offers services ranging from civil engineering and building construction to equipment hire and logistics.

## Services

- Civil engineering and building construction
- Heavy equipment hire (excavators, loaders, graders, tippers, trailers, rollers, cranes)
- Transportation and logistics
- Quarry and aggregate supply
- Mining support services
- ECTS (Electronic Cargo Tracking System) services

## Equipment Fleet

The company operates a fleet including excavators, wheel loaders, motor graders, dump trucks, flatbed trailers, drum rollers, cranes, backhoes, and pickup trucks.

## Projects

Ongoing and completed projects include:

- Julius Nyerere Hydropower Plant and Dam — Subcontractor
- Standard Gauge Railway (SGR) — Subcontractor
- Amarachi Quarry — Lugoba Quarry — Project Owner
- Kabulo-Kiwira Coal Mine — Tenderee
- Coal Transportation Project — Transporter
- Maintenance of Pangani Road — Tanga Section — Subcontractor
- Construction of a Warehouse in Ubungo District, Dar es Salaam — Contractor (NSSF, completed 2024)
- Construction of Rigid Pavement Road, Super to Golani 4km — Contractor (TARURA, completed 2025)
